networkAccess.reasoning: Two endpoints: (1) ws://localhost:3055 — local CLI on 127.0.0.1, used by the user's own AI coding tool (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Gemini, …) to read the current Figma selection and score it. (2) https://script.google.com — only contacted when the user types feedback into the in-plugin 'Send a suggestion' box and clicks Send. The text the user typed is the only thing sent; no design content, file contents, selection data, telemetry, or analytics are transmitted.
